name: Tax 38
definition: Tax related to an investment fund order.

Basis.name: Basis
Basis.definition: Basis used to determine the capital gain or loss.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of money resulting from the calculation of the tax.

Country.name: Country
Country.definition: Country where the tax is due.

ExemptionIndicator.name: Exemption Indicator
ExemptionIndicator.definition: Indicates whether a tax exemption applies.

RecipientIdentification.name: Recipient Identification
RecipientIdentification.definition: Party that receives the tax. The recipient of, and the party entitled to, the tax may be two different parties.

TaxCalculationDetails.name: Tax Calculation Details
TaxCalculationDetails.definition: Information used to calculate the tax.
